svg.title: The ladders of efficiency
svg.desc: Nine ladders, each escalating only as far as the work demands: solution, capture, emission budgets, graduated engagement, window pressure, guard modes, policy epochs, deployment tiers and model tiers. Each row shows its rungs left to right, who climbs it (the model, the hook, or a static setting), and whether its traversal is actually measured — three are, four are partial, two are not scored at all.
svg.text: cheapest rung first · escalate only on evidence
RUNGS → escalate only as far as needed
Three ladders have receipts, four are instrumented without a traversal metric, two are never scored.
A ladder nobody measures is a ladder nobody knows is being climbed — which is why this is an audit, not a feature list.
